PR Summary by Qodo

Add Save all for received photos and videos ✨ Enhancement 🧪 Tests 📝 Documentation 🕐 20-40 Minutes
AI Description

>
>• Add one-tap sharing of received files, with spaced downloads when batch sharing is unavailable.
>• Skip files already saved and report files still arriving.
>• Add unit and two-browser coverage; this is a test PR and must not be merged.
>
Merge Risk 🟡 Medium

Blast radius 🟡 Medium 💥 2 capabilities

- 2 affected capabilities within one bounded functional scope: received-file saving integration. - This is one bounded browser integration: selecting received files and handing them to either the share sheet or local downloads. - The path starts at the Save all click, reads the local files/prints/incoming state, and ends at the browser handoff; no independent server or downstream functional scope is involved. - This is a distinct user operation within the same bounded received-file saving integration: saving one selected received file. - It shares the local file state and browser handoff boundary with bulk save, but has a separate user outcome and entry point; it does not create an independent functional scope.
Sources
[web/index.html\[326-333\]](https://github.com/jtbinith/qodo-hack-2026/blob/1eb205051c9221d2851166bffbd07aad9f27d701/web/index.html#L326-L333) ```html // handed over once it was shared or its download started, so Save all doesn't save it again (F13) if (navigator.canShare?.({ files: [file] })) navigator.share({ files: [file] }).then(() => saveAll.handed.add(p.pid), () => {}); else { downloadFile(file); saveAll.handed.add(p.pid); } } function downloadFile(file) { const a = document.createElement('a'), url = URL.createObjectURL(file); a.href = url; a.download = file.name; a.click(); setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), REVOKE_AFTER); ``` [web/saveall.js\[47-55\]](https://github.com/jtbinith/qodo-hack-2026/blob/1eb205051c9221d2851166bffbd07aad9f27d701/web/saveall.js#L47-L55) ```javascript for (const r of ready) handed.add(r.pid); return toast(`Shared ${ready.length}${more(arriving)}`); } toast(`Downloading ${ready.length}${more(arriving)}`); for (let i = 0; i < ready.length; i++) { if (i) await wait(DOWNLOAD_GAP); try { download(ready[i].file); handed.add(ready[i].pid); } catch (e) { console.warn('download failed', ready[i].file?.name, e); } } } finally { busy = false; } ```
Behavioral complexity 🔴 High 🧩 Multiple interactions

- Before, there was no bulk-save state machine. - After, the changed logic coordinates eligibility selection, share-sheet support, share cancellation/failure, fallback-to-download on the next tap, per-file handoff marking, spaced downloads, and a busy guard. - The new correctness conditions are that only fully received non-owned files are selected; cancellation does not mark files; a non-cancellation share failure does not autonomously download but changes the next-tap mode; each successful handoff is marked exactly once; download failures remain retryable; and overlapping taps cannot interleave batches. - These are newly interacting states and ordering conditions rather than merely reuse of an existing helper.
Sources
[web/saveall.js\[47-55\]](https://github.com/jtbinith/qodo-hack-2026/blob/1eb205051c9221d2851166bffbd07aad9f27d701/web/saveall.js#L47-L55) ```javascript for (const r of ready) handed.add(r.pid); return toast(`Shared ${ready.length}${more(arriving)}`); } toast(`Downloading ${ready.length}${more(arriving)}`); for (let i = 0; i < ready.length; i++) { if (i) await wait(DOWNLOAD_GAP); try { download(ready[i].file); handed.add(ready[i].pid); } catch (e) { console.warn('download failed', ready[i].file?.name, e); } } } finally { busy = false; } ```
Potential damage 🟢 Low 🩹 Reversible

- If this capability regresses, a user may be unable to save some or all already received files, may need to save them individually, or may see a repeated/incorrect handoff. - The source files remain in the browser's in-memory files map, so recovery is normally a later tap or individual save; a browser reload or loss of the in-memory room state would require receiving the files again. - No persistent application state or external side effect beyond browser handoff is changed. - Generally recoverable by retrying Save all, using individual save, or re-receiving files if the page state is lost. - A cancelled share explicitly leaves files available; failed individual downloads are retried because their pid is not marked handed. - No automatic recovery worker exists.
Sources
[web/saveall.js\[47-55\]](https://github.com/jtbinith/qodo-hack-2026/blob/1eb205051c9221d2851166bffbd07aad9f27d701/web/saveall.js#L47-L55) ```javascript for (const r of ready) handed.add(r.pid); return toast(`Shared ${ready.length}${more(arriving)}`); } toast(`Downloading ${ready.length}${more(arriving)}`); for (let i = 0; i < ready.length; i++) { if (i) await wait(DOWNLOAD_GAP); try { download(ready[i].file); handed.add(ready[i].pid); } catch (e) { console.warn('download failed', ready[i].file?.name, e); } } } finally { busy = false; } ``` [web/index.html\[326-333\]](https://github.com/jtbinith/qodo-hack-2026/blob/1eb205051c9221d2851166bffbd07aad9f27d701/web/index.html#L326-L333) ```html // handed over once it was shared or its download started, so Save all doesn't save it again (F13) if (navigator.canShare?.({ files: [file] })) navigator.share({ files: [file] }).then(() => saveAll.handed.add(p.pid), () => {}); else { downloadFile(file); saveAll.handed.add(p.pid); } } function downloadFile(file) { const a = document.createElement('a'), url = URL.createObjectURL(file); a.href = url; a.download = file.name; a.click(); setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), REVOKE_AFTER); ```
Assessed commit 1eb2050
Diagram

```mermaid graph TD UI["Save all button"] --> Batch["Select received files"] --> Choice{"Batch share available?"} Choice -->|yes| Share["Share sheet"] --> Handed["Track handed files"] Choice -->|no| Download["Spaced downloads"] --> Handed Files["Received files"] --> Batch ```
High-Level Assessment

>Keep the separate, testable batch controller and native share-or-download approach. Individual share-sheet calls would lose the one-tap experience, while packaging files into an archive would change how recipients receive photos.

Code Review by Qodo

🐞 Bugs (4) 📎 Requirement gaps (1)
1. Save all keeps downloading after one failed share sheet 📎 Requirement gap
>
>Description >
> >
>createSaveAll sets downloadNext to true after a non-AbortError share failure, but tap()
>never clears it after the fallback batch. Every later tap skips canShare and goes to downloads,
>including taps after newly received photos, while the existing rejection test stops before that
>behavior is exposed.
>
>
>
>Code >
> >[web/saveall.js[R26-44]](https://github.com/jtbinith/qodo-hack-2026/pull/143/files#diff-1197fbbadbb14a53258dbd75d68b20c8bf37f2e49062120e60b6b11916a8861fR26-R44) > >```diff >+ let downloadNext = false; // the share sheet failed: the next tap downloads instead >+ let busy = false; // a share sheet or a download batch is still running >+ const more = (n) => (n ? ` · ${n} still arriving` : ''); >+ >+ // Everything is decided, and the share sheet opened, before the first await: the share sheet >+ // only opens inside the tap (iOS rule) >+ async function tap() { >+ if (busy) return toast('Still saving'); >+ const { ready, arriving } = batch(handed); >+ if (!ready.length) return toast(arriving ? `Nothing to save yet${more(arriving)}` : 'Nothing new to save'); >+ const list = ready.map((r) => r.file); >+ let sharing = false; >+ if (!downloadNext) { try { sharing = !!canShare(list); } catch { sharing = false; } } >+ busy = true; >+ try { >+ if (sharing) { >+ try { await share(list); } catch (e) { >+ if (e?.name === 'AbortError') return; // cancelled: nothing happens, the photos stay available >+ downloadNext = true; >``` >
>
>Agent prompt >
> >``` >The issue below was found during a code review. Follow the provided context and guidance below and implement a solution > >## Issue description >In `web/saveall.js`, a non-`AbortError` share failure sets `downloadNext`, but the flag remains set after the intended one-batch fallback. Subsequent taps therefore skip the share sheet, including when new photos arrive. > >## Fix Focus Areas >- web/saveall.js[24-58] >- tests/saveall.test.mjs[102-115] > >## Recommended Fix >Consume and clear `downloadNext` on the next tap, even if there is nothing left to download. For example, capture it in a local variable at the start of `tap()`, reset the flag to `false`, and use the captured value in the `canShare` check; keep the share-failure path setting the flag to `true`. Extend the rejection test with a tap after the fallback batch, supplying another photo, and assert that `share` is called again. >``` > ⓘ Copy this prompt and use it to remediate the issue with your preferred AI generation tools >
[Dismiss ↗](https://app.qodo.ai/findings/a3cbf7b2-9f8b-449d-be2e-ad84580b30aa?action=dismiss&origin=git) | [View ↗](https://app.qodo.ai/findings/a3cbf7b2-9f8b-449d-be2e-ad84580b30aa)

2. One photo downloads twice during a batch 🐞 Bug
>
>Description >
> >
>tap() snapshots the files to download and does not recheck handed after each wait, while
>individual save(p) can download and mark one of those files during that wait. On a device without
>file sharing, tapping a print before its turn in a running Save all batch starts its download
>immediately, and the batch downloads it again.
>
>
>
>Code >
> >[web/saveall.js[R51-53]](https://github.com/jtbinith/qodo-hack-2026/pull/143/files#diff-1197fbbadbb14a53258dbd75d68b20c8bf37f2e49062120e60b6b11916a8861fR51-R53) > >```diff >+ for (let i = 0; i < ready.length; i++) { >+ if (i) await wait(DOWNLOAD_GAP); >+ try { download(ready[i].file); handed.add(ready[i].pid); } catch (e) { console.warn('download failed', ready[i].file?.name, e); } >``` >
>
>Agent prompt >
> >``` >The issue below was found during a code review. Follow the provided context and guidance below and implement a solution > >## Issue description >An individual print save can download a file while an earlier Save all batch is waiting to download that same file. >## Fix Focus Areas >- web/saveall.js[50-54] >- web/index.html[323-343] >## Recommended Fix >Coordinate both entry points through shared in-flight state. At minimum, recheck whether each PID has been handed over immediately before starting its batch download, and test an individual save during the gap between batch downloads. >``` > ⓘ Copy this prompt and use it to remediate the issue with your preferred AI generation tools >

3. Failed downloads go unnoticed 🐞 Bug
>
>Description >
> >
>createSaveAll.tap() catches a synchronous download failure with console.warn but leaves the
>earlier Downloading N toast unchanged. If creating the object URL or clicking its link throws, the
>photo remains eligible for retry, but the person is not told that its download did not start.
>
>
>
>Code >
> >[web/saveall.js[R50-53]](https://github.com/jtbinith/qodo-hack-2026/pull/143/files#diff-1197fbbadbb14a53258dbd75d68b20c8bf37f2e49062120e60b6b11916a8861fR50-R53) > >```diff >+ toast(`Downloading ${ready.length}${more(arriving)}`); >+ for (let i = 0; i < ready.length; i++) { >+ if (i) await wait(DOWNLOAD_GAP); >+ try { download(ready[i].file); handed.add(ready[i].pid); } catch (e) { console.warn('download failed', ready[i].file?.name, e); } >``` >
>
>Agent prompt >
> >``` >The issue below was found during a code review. Follow the provided context and guidance below and implement a solution > >## Issue description >A synchronous download error is logged but leaves the person seeing only the batch's initial progress message. >## Fix Focus Areas >- web/saveall.js[50-55] >- tests/saveall.test.mjs[164-180] >## Recommended Fix >Count downloads whose start throws and show a follow-up toast identifying that some did not start and can be retried. Keep failed PIDs out of `handed`, and assert the warning in the existing failure test. Do not claim to detect downloads the browser accepted but did not retain. >``` > ⓘ Copy this prompt and use it to remediate the issue with your preferred AI generation tools >
[Dismiss ↗](https://app.qodo.ai/findings/c3cf91eb-db1f-45e8-a484-fa3681e2b387?action=dismiss&origin=git) | [View ↗](https://app.qodo.ai/findings/c3cf91eb-db1f-45e8-a484-fa3681e2b387)
4. Finishing photos vanish from the count 🐞 Bug
>
>Description >
> >
>saveBatch derives its still-arriving count solely from incoming, but the chunk handler deletes
>that entry before done() awaits checksum verification. A tap during verification sees the photo in
>neither incoming nor files, so Save all can say Nothing new to save even though the photo is
>still being finalized.
>
>
>
>Code >
> >[web/saveall.js[R16-17]](https://github.com/jtbinith/qodo-hack-2026/pull/143/files#diff-1197fbbadbb14a53258dbd75d68b20c8bf37f2e49062120e60b6b11916a8861fR16-R17) > >```diff >+ let arriving = 0; >+ for (const fid of incoming.keys()) if (!fid.startsWith('thumb:') && !files.has(fid)) arriving++; >``` >
>
>Agent prompt >
> >``` >The issue below was found during a code review. Follow the provided context and guidance below and implement a solution > >## Issue description >Removing a completed transfer from `incoming` before its checksum finishes temporarily hides it from Save all's still-arriving count. >## Fix Focus Areas >- web/saveall.js[10-18] >- web/index.html[205-239] >## Recommended Fix >Track full-photo transfers undergoing verification as well as those receiving chunks, and include both states in the still-arriving count until the verified file is installed or the transfer fails. >``` > ⓘ Copy this prompt and use it to remediate the issue with your preferred AI generation tools >

5. An unsettled share locks out later taps 🐞 Bug
>
>Description >
> >
>createSaveAll.tap() clears busy only when its awaited share promise settles, with no recovery
>path for one that remains pending. If the browser leaves that promise unsettled, every later Save
>all tap returns Still saving and cannot hand over the available photos.
>
>
>
>Code >
> >[web/saveall.js[R41-42]](https://github.com/jtbinith/qodo-hack-2026/pull/143/files#diff-1197fbbadbb14a53258dbd75d68b20c8bf37f2e49062120e60b6b11916a8861fR41-R42) > >```diff >+ if (sharing) { >+ try { await share(list); } catch (e) { >``` >
>
>Agent prompt >
> >``` >The issue below was found during a code review. Follow the provided context and guidance below and implement a solution > >## Issue description >A share promise that never settles holds Save all's busy state indefinitely. >## Fix Focus Areas >- web/saveall.js[32-55] >- tests/saveall.test.mjs[90-115] >## Recommended Fix >Provide an explicit, user-visible recovery path for an exceptionally long pending share without starting downloads automatically. Account for a late share resolution so recovery cannot hand over the same photos twice, and test a promise that remains pending. >``` > ⓘ Copy this prompt and use it to remediate the issue with your preferred AI generation tools >
